board: Editor Shell — default (Insert open, no selection) @1440
_note: Targets address elements by data-testid, never by CSS class. This file used
to wait on `.bd-topbar` and measure `.bd-bp-switcher`, and NEITHER class
exists in any file under src/ — so the run died on its first step and had
never produced a measurement at all. They were not typos: chrome wears only
tw:-prefixed utility classes, so there was no stable class to name.
Anchors live in Topbar.tsx, LeftSidebar.tsx, Canvas.tsx and
CanvasFooterToolbar.tsx; check-anchors.mjs fails in ~1s when a recipe names
one that no longer exists in src/.
A target carries `spec` + `nodeId` when a Figma board covers it. Targets
without them are SKIPPED by diff.mjs and counted in the report header, so
coverage cannot shrink quietly. A shell surface legitimately draws from
several component boards, which is why the join is per-target rather than
`states` are measured in ONE page visit: default, then each state applied,
read and reset, then default read AGAIN and compared byte-for-byte against
the first. That re-read is the whole safety argument for sharing a page —
a hover left on, or focus never blurred, looks exactly like real drift.
